name: GPT4All
tagline: Desktop offline chatbot optimized for CPU-only laptops and local document chat
real_test_summary: Ran Llama 3.2 3B Instruct on a CPU-only MacBook Air M2 at ~38 tokens/sec with LocalDocs folder indexing active.
pros: One-click GUI installer built specifically for CPU-only PCs
MIT open-source license with optional zero-telemetry mode
cons: Fewer advanced server API flags than llama.cpp
Larger models run slowly on older Intel/AMD CPUs
description: Privacy-first desktop application allowing users without dedicated GPUs to download quantized GGUF models and chat with local folders of PDF and Markdown files offline.
